Four Arrested in Bengaluru University Online Fraud Case

The Karnataka Cyber Command has arrested four individuals in connection with an online fraud that defrauded a Bengaluru university of Rs 1.40 crore. A fifth accused is reported to be absconding. The fraud reportedly involved a fake WhatsApp profile and a ZIP file.
